subtitle: 刘纪霆
headline:
Multimodal Foundation Models & Embodied AI
Undergraduate in Mathematics
bioMarkdown:
I am an undergraduate in **Mathematics**, with expected graduation in **2028**.

My research interests are primarily in **multimodal foundation models and embodied AI**. Recently, I have been exploring **dynamic parameter generation**, focusing on generating or adjusting model parameters based on tasks and context.

I previously served as a Research Assistant at **HKU’s** [Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab](https://hku-cg.github.io/mirod-lab/) and **Shanghai Jiao Tong University’s** [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/).
